stories.title: Dandridge police arrest man wanted for aggravated assault
stories.summary: The East Tennessee Valley Crime Stoppers said Elijah Davis is now facing additional drug and weapons-related charges

stories.title: Pedestrian in critical condition after Chapman Hwy crash
stories.summary: Knoxville police said the driver initially left the scene but called 911 to report their involvement.

stories.title: Sevier County Humane Society recalls heroic rescue of 100 animals during wildfires 10 years ago
stories.summary: During the wildfires in 2016, Sevier County Humane Society rescued 100 pets, setting up a temporary shelter at the fairgrounds.

stories.title: Blount County residents voice concerns over license plate reading cameras at public hearing
stories.summary: Many speakers called for the county to remove the cameras, while others defended their use as a tool for law enforcement.

stories.title: 10Investigates: Knoxville tour bus company cancels trips, citing insurance issues
stories.summary: Longtime customers of Knoxville Tours are frustrated after the company canceled trips and delayed refunds, blaming insurance issues.

stories.title: Leaders hope to expand Mission District outreach program
stories.summary: Organizers hope to expand the Mission District Medical Team, which connects those experiencing homelessness with medical care and other resources.

stories.title: Mayor to request $70M for upgrades to Knoxville Civic Auditorium and Convention Center
stories.summary: Mayor Kincannon plans to ask city council to approve the funding, allocated in 20-year bonds, for improvements to both facilities, at a council meeting on Nov. 24.

stories.title: Judge sentences Anderson Co. man to another 180 years on top of life sentence for woman's murder
stories.summary: An Anderson County judge sentenced Jason Dockery to an additional 180 years for charges related to the murder of Shysti Mayberry.

stories.title: Knox County works to improve traffic congestion on Hardin Valley Road
stories.summary: The well-trafficked three-lane road in Hardin Valley will be expanded to five lanes. Construction is expected to start in the Spring or Summer of 2027.

stories.title: William Blount Head Coach Robert Reeves steps down
stories.summary: Robert Reeves has stepped down as head football coach at William Blount following a 1-9 season.

stories.title: $225K grant aims to bring new life to downtown Lenoir City
stories.summary: Lenoir City is set to revitalize its downtown area with a $225,000 state grant aimed at funding building improvements.

stories.title: Second Harvest Food Bank announces times for Knoxville holiday drive-thru distribution ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Officials with Second Harvest Food Bank of East Tennessee said they will host their annual drive-thru distribution at Redemption Church on Nov. 18.
